articles.summary: NEW YORK – Nov 4, 2026 – Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) (“Coty” or “the Company”) today announced a long-term extension of its Marc Jacobs license with WHP Global and G-III Apparel Group, which co-own the Marc Jacobs brand. The extension secures one of the core brands in Coty’s Prestige portfolio for decades to come.
articles.title: Coty Extends Marc Jacobs License, Securing 40-Year License Duration
